dossier.headline: Cochin Shipyard slides after a weak September quarter
dossier.summary: Cochin Shipyard shares fell about 8% to ₹1,186.50 on November 11 after Q2 FY27 net profit halved to ₹54 crore, even as consolidated revenue rose about 11.7%. The fall came on a day when the broader market rallied.
why_it_matters: A rare large decliner on a broadly strong day, driven purely by results
